module.purpose: Defines the tldraw shape utility for note shapes, including rendering, geometry, text measurement, editing behavior, resizing, duplication, attribution, and SVG export.
module.summary: This module implements the complete behavior of editable note shapes in the tldraw editor. It supplies display defaults, geometry and handles, React and SVG rendering, rich-text measurement with adaptive font sizing, keyboard navigation to adjacent notes, attribution tracking, resize behavior, and shape lifecycle updates. The implementation integrates editor state, themes, translations, rich-text utilities, and deterministic visual effects.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative visual note-taking and diagramming. If it fails, notes may render incorrectly, lose text attribution, mis-size content, or become difficult to edit and navigate.
